## Rights declaration / 權利聲明

Every box is required. If any statement is uncertain, do not submit the files.

每一項都必須勾選；只要有任何一項不確定，就不要上傳。

- [ ] I created this original character, or I own sufficient written rights to modify and redistribute it.
- [ ] 此角色由我原創，或我擁有足夠的書面權利修改與再散布。
- [ ] This is not fan art and does not contain or imitate a recognizable third-party character, celebrity, brand, logo, costume, artwork, photograph, or trademark.
- [ ] 這不是二創，也不包含或模仿可辨識的第三方角色、名人、品牌、Logo、服裝、美術、照片或商標。
- [ ] I did not download any submitted image from a website, social platform, asset store, search engine, or another creator.
- [ ] 我沒有從網站、社群、素材商店、搜尋引擎或其他創作者下載本次投稿圖片。
- [ ] If AI tools were used, their terms permit this use and I reviewed the result for third-party intellectual property.
- [ ] 若使用 AI 工具，其條款允許此用途，而且我已檢查結果不含第三方智慧財產。
- [ ] I authorize redistribution and modification under the license declared in `persona.json`.
- [ ] 我同意依照 `persona.json` 聲明的授權條款進行修改與再散布。
- [ ] I understand that a false declaration may result in immediate rejection or removal.
- [ ] 我了解不實聲明可能導致投稿立即被拒絕或移除。

## Technical checks / 技術檢查

- [ ] The folder contains only `persona.json`, `preview.png`, and `spritesheet.png`.
- [ ] 資料夾內只有 `persona.json`、`preview.png` 與 `spritesheet.png`。
- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes.
- [ ] I reviewed the animation for clipping, unstable size, baseline jumps, white backgrounds, and frame overlap.
- [ ] 我已檢查裁切、尺寸跳動、基準線跳動、白底與跨格重疊。
